title: Stop roaming for what saintly company gives
summary: This meets the exhausted spiritual search that keeps mistaking motion for nearness. The line says techniques and travel cannot make peace arrive; saintly company can.
takeaway: Let seeking kneel into saintly company.
lifeApplication: Before changing methods again, sit down where the mind and body cool in honest company. Stay long enough for the chase to quiet.

source.shortMeaning: Restless searching settles when saintly company cools the mind and body.
source.lifeApplication: When the urge to roam returns, stay near the company that brings composure.

evidence.coreClaim: Restless searching settles when saintly company cools the mind and body.
evidence.turn: Bring your searching to holy company and let it cool there.
